sections.Description: Ballantine’s blended Scotch whisky is exported to over 160 countries and is one of the biggest Scotch brands in the world. Ballantine’s blends malt and grain whiskies from all four whisky regions of Scotland, Speyside, Islay, Highlands and Lowlands. The recipe of the Ballantine’s Finest is the most ancient of the distillery’s whisky recipes, and it was formulated as early as 1910 by the Ballantine family. It contains over 40 whisky malts and grains, carefully chosen from the four regions owned by the Scottish distillery, which is rated third in the world among the best-selling whisky brands. Ballantine’s Finest has remained true to the original recipe since 1910 and is also Ballantine’s very first recipe

notes: Balanced, Subtle Sweet Aroma, Chocolate, Red Apples, Vanilla
Soft, Elegant, Spicy, Notes of Honey, Heather

sections.Description: Black & White Whisky is a classic blended whisky. His trademark is the two terriers, Black & White. It is one of the most popular and well-known Scotch Whiskies with a very long history. Because the brand Black & White Whisky was brought into being almost 200 years ago. This was done by the company Buchanan & Co Ltd, which James Buchanan founded. Therefore, the Black & White Scotch was initially marketed as “The Buchanan Blend” and later renamed “House of Commons”. Because his customers always ordered only the “Black & White” because of the black and white label, the whisky was also called “The Buchanan Blend” from then on. Also the idea for the famous terriers, a black Scottish Terrier and a white West Highland White Terrier, still came from the founder himself

With the establishment of the Bulleit distillery, Tom Bulleit has fulfilled a dream. He was inspired by his great-great-grandfather Augustus Bulleit. The subtlety and complexity of Bulleit Bourbon come from its unique blend of rye, corn, and barley malt, along with special strains of yeast and pure Kentucky limestone filtered water. Due to its especially high rye content, Bulleit Bourbon has a bold, spicy character with a finish that’s distinctively clean and smooth. Medium amber in colour, with gentle spiciness and sweet oak aromas. Mid-palate is smooth with tones of maple, oak, and nutmeg. The finish is long, dry, and satiny with a light toffee flavour. Bulleit Bourbon has been awarded the Mixology Bar Award 2014 – Spirit of the Year!

notes: Spicy, Vanilla, Notes of Maple, Oak, Nutmeg

sections.Description: Auchentoshan 12 Years is a remarkably good whisky from the Lowlands. Unlike other single malt whiskies, the Auchentoshan 12 Years has been distilled three times as compared to other single malts being distilled twice. Auchentoshan 12 Years is particularly smooth and pure in taste and matures in North American Bourbon oak casks. This whisky won the Silver Medal in 2018 at the International Spirits Challenge

sections.Description: The name Auchentoshan “Three Wood” mirrors the number of times the whisky has been distilled. The name Three Wood is due to the maturation in 3 different wooden barrels. This whisky matures for about 10 years in ex-Bourbon casks, then in Oloroso Sherry casks for an estimated 2 years before it is finally put into a PX-Sherry cask for another 6 months to add a good punch of sweetness. The Auchentoshan Three Wood whiskey won the Silver Mental in 2018 at the International Spirits Challenge and Chairman’s Trophy in 2012 at the Ultimate Cocktail challenge for the best Scotch Whisky

sections.Description: The first Triple Malt Scotch Whisky worldwide! The name is to be understood as a reminiscence of the traditions: In the old days, distillery workers used to shovel the germinating barley by the ton, hour after hour by hand. From this hard work, their shoulders sometimes hurt and their arms hung down low, almost like a chimpanzee. These temporary ailments were called ‘monkey shoulders’ and this Scotch was named after them. Monkey Shoulder is a blend of whisky from Balvenie, Glenfiddich and Kininvie, hence the name ‘Triple Malt’. Unlike traditional blends, Monkey Shoulder is 100% malt whisky

sections.Description: The motto of Jack Daniel was “Every day we make it, we’ll make it the best we can”. For him, this meant filtering his whisky drop by drop through a three-meter thick layer of charcoal from the sugar maple. Seven generations later, whisky is still filtered in the same way Jack used to filter it. The reason for this: Filtering gives it the unmistakable mildness that you’d expect from Jack Daniel’s. The Charcoal Mellowing makes Jack Daniel’s what it is: not bourbon, but a Tennessee whisky. This process refines the full taste of the whisky, even more so when it is fully matured in casks of Jack Daniel’s own production. This is a laborious process that requires special attention and makes the whisky a little more expensive to make. However, another process would not have met with Jack’s approval

The 12-year-old Balvenie Double Wood first matures in Bourbon barrels (10 years unverified). For perfection, it is then matured in Spanish Sherry First-Fill barrels

Glenfiddich is a whisky distillery near Dufftown in the former County Banffshire in Scotland and is the largest single malt producer in Scotland. The Glenfiddich 12 Years Old is a classic among the single malt whiskies, which matures for 12 years in oak casks and has a distinctive harmonious taste. The pioneer of the single malt category is matured in the best oloroso sherry and bourbon casks. Uniquely united in oak casks, it develops superbly balanced fresh and complex notes. A Scotch whisky that is particularly well suited for beginners.

sections.Description: A truly exceptional single malt, the result not just of eighteen years of care and attention, but of whisky-making craft and knowledge passed down through the generations. Each note of maturing whisky grows and develops over time inside the casks. The baked apple notes of the whisky were once notes of fresh pear, now mellowed and softened. Spanish Oloroso wood and American oak are used to mature this rich, intriguingly fruity and robust oak expression, but there are many more reasons why this expression is special. Each has extraordinary consistency and character from an intense marrying period, and a warming, distinguished finish.

Matured for 12 years in a blend of American oak ex-bourbon and sherry casks, it develops a smooth, rich character with a golden hue. This whisky is known as “The Golden Dram,” celebrated for its honeyed richness, fragrant fruit, and gentle spice. On the nose you’ll find plump, spiced fruits with heather honey and creamy vanilla, while the palate delivers rounded sweetness, orchard fruit, and soft oak

sections.Description: Singha Beer is Thailand’s iconic premium lager, brewed by Boon Rawd Brewery since the early 1930s. Characterized by a bright golden colour, smooth malt sweetness, balanced hop bitterness, and a crisp, refreshing finish. With a 5.0% ABV, Singha delivers a classic, easy-drinking lager profile that pairs well with a range of cuisines and social occasions

notes: Smooth malt body with balanced hop bitterness and light fruity notes
Light malt aroma with subtle hops character
Crisp, refreshing finish that’s easy to drink

sections.Description: A small-batch handcrafted gin, Bombay Sapphire Premier Cru celebrates Murcia’s world-renowned citrus and is made with sustainably-sourced Murcian Fino lemons, mandarins and sweet navel oranges, hand-picked and hand-peeled from the late harvest. The aromatic character and opulent citrus notes imparted by these botanicals make the London Dry Gin a stand out in cocktails such as the Martini or French 75.

The exceptionally smooth flavour of Cross Keys Gin unlocks the door to the ephemeral beauty of Baltic summer. Discover unique blend of flavours – a well-balanced interplay between the traditional juniper, light breeze of local herbals and a touch of sun ripened black currant sweetness

Hendricks Gin is handmade in small quantities and is distilled four times in small 19th-century gin stills. Hendricks Gin has been around since 1886 and is still bottled in an old pharmacist’s bottle. This gin should only be drunk pure or with water. For a highlight, put a slice of cucumber in the glass

notes: Mild, Floral, Earthy, Citrus, Juniper Berries, Hints of Fennel, Liquorice

sections.Description: Tanqueray N° TEN is a meeting of passion and attention. The name ‘N° TEN’ is derived from the number of the boiler that survived the German air raid in 1941. This boiler with the number 10, also called ‘Tiny Ten’, is still in operation today. Tanqueray N° TEN is the only gin to be inducted into the San Francisco World Spirits Competition Hall of Fame!

notes: Complex, Juniper Berries, Coriander, Notes of Cirtus, Grapefruit, Lime, Hints of Chamomile
Juniper, Notes of Grapefruit, Hints of Lime, Cirtus

sections.Description: Glenfiddich is a whisky distillery near Dufftown in the former County Banffshire in Scotland and is the largest single malt producer in Scotland. The Glenfiddich 12 Years Old is a classic among the single malt whiskies, which matures for 12 years in oak casks and has a distinctive harmonious taste. The pioneer of the single malt category is matured in the best oloroso sherry and bourbon casks. Uniquely united in oak casks, it develops superbly balanced fresh and complex notes. A Scotch whisky that is particularly well suited for beginners.

notes: Dry, Balanced, Light Peat and Pine Notes, Fresh Pear Aroma, Malty

sections.Description: Lucifer’s Gold is a blended whisky created by combining Scotch whisky and Kentucky bourbon in equal parts, resulting in a unique hybrid spirit that balances characteristics of both styles. sections.Description: Since the foundation of the Balvenie distillery, there have been hardly any changes; the Single Malts are still produced in the traditional way. sections.Description: Auchentoshan 12 Years is a remarkably good whisky from the Lowlands. sections.Description: Mother of Pearl Vodka is a premium Australian vodka brand inspired by the pristine coastal waters and the natural beauty of Australia’s shoreline. This grape base, along with a unique multi-stage distillation and filtration process, creates a smooth, neutral spirit with a silky, creamy, pearl-like finish and less “heat” on the palate, making it ideal neat, on ice, or as a cocktail base. Notes of honey, citrus, vanilla, and subtle maritime influences are complemented by layers of dark chocolate and soft smoke, creating a refined and approachable drinking experience. The long maturation process allows the whisky to develop exceptional depth while preserving the distinctive coastal character that has made Bowmore a benchmark among Islay whiskies

notes: Balanced peat smoke, dark chocolate, honey, citrus, subtle sea salt

sections.Description: Bowmore 18 Years Old is an award-winning Islay single malt Scotch whisky matured for eighteen years to achieve remarkable depth, complexity, and elegance. Influenced by both traditional oak maturation and sherry-seasoned casks, this exceptional whisky delivers a rich combination of dark chocolate, dried fruits, caramelized sweetness, and gentle peat smoke. The extended aging process enhances the whisky’s smooth texture and refined character while maintaining Bowmore’s signature maritime style. Rich, balanced, and sophisticated, Bowmore 18 is highly regarded among whisky enthusiasts seeking a premium Islay expression with exceptional complexity and a lingering finish

sections.Description: Buffalo Trace Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is the flagship bourbon of the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery, carrying more than two centuries of American whiskey-making heritage. Crafted from carefully selected corn, rye, and malted barley, the bourbon is aged for years in new charred oak barrels within century-old warehouses before reaching peak maturity. The result is a rich and complex bourbon with notes of vanilla, brown sugar, toffee, dark fruits, and gentle spice, supported by a smooth and well-balanced structure. Recognized worldwide for its consistency and quality, Buffalo Trace remains one of the most respected and awarded bourbons in the industry

sections.Description: Jim Beam Apple combines the smooth character of authentic Kentucky Straight Bourbon with the crisp and refreshing flavor of green apples. The result is a versatile flavored whiskey that balances the natural sweetness of fruit with classic bourbon notes of vanilla, caramel, and oak. Light, approachable, and easy to enjoy, Jim Beam Apple can be served neat, over ice, or as the foundation of a variety of refreshing cocktails. Its vibrant fruit-forward profile makes it an ideal choice for both whiskey enthusiasts and newcomers alike

notes: Crisp apple, bourbon sweetness, light oak

sections.Description: Jim Beam Honey is a smooth and flavorful blend of genuine Jim Beam Kentucky Straight Bourbon and natural honey liqueur. The sweetness of golden honey is carefully balanced with the rich vanilla, oak, and caramel notes found in the original bourbon, creating a distinctive whiskey experience that is both sweet and bold. With its mellow character and approachable profile, Jim Beam Honey offers a versatile drinking experience that can be enjoyed neat, chilled, over ice, or mixed into cocktails

sections.Description: Maker’s Mark is a handcrafted Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey renowned for its smooth and approachable character. Unlike many traditional bourbons that use rye in their mash bill, Maker’s Mark incorporates soft red winter wheat, resulting in a richer and more mellow flavor profile. Carefully aged in charred American oak barrels and bottled by taste rather than age, the bourbon delivers notes of caramel, vanilla, toasted oak, and baking spices with remarkable balance and consistency. Its iconic hand-dipped red wax seal has become a symbol of premium American craftsmanship recognized around the world

sections.Description: Wild Turkey 81 is a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey crafted using a traditional high-rye mash bill and matured in heavily charred American oak barrels. Developed under the expertise of Wild Turkey’s master distillers, this bourbon offers a balanced combination of sweet vanilla, caramel, honey, and toasted oak alongside subtle spice and citrus notes. The approachable proof allows the whiskey’s rich character to shine while maintaining exceptional smoothness, making it suitable for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in classic bourbon cocktails

sections.Description: Broker’s London Dry Gin is a traditional English gin produced using a carefully selected blend of classic botanicals, including juniper berries, coriander seeds, citrus peels, and aromatic herbs. Crisp, clean, and exceptionally balanced, Broker’s delivers vibrant juniper character supported by refreshing citrus and subtle spice, making it an excellent choice for premium gin and tonic serves as well as classic cocktails

Broker’s Pink Gin combines the award-winning character of Broker’s London Dry Gin with vibrant berry flavors to create a refreshing and contemporary gin experience. Built upon the brand’s traditional botanical foundation, this expression introduces natural fruit notes that complement the classic juniper-forward profile. The result is a smooth, aromatic, and fruit-driven gin that offers balance between sweetness and botanical complexity. Crafted from Luxardo Marasca cherries, including both the fruit and portions of the cherry pits, the liqueur undergoes a meticulous distillation and maturation process that creates its distinctive aroma and flavor profile. With an alcohol content of 18.2% ABV and a volume of 500 ml, it offers a light-bodied profile featuring floral, herbal, and fruity notes. Its aroma includes chrysanthemum, goji berries, mandarin, and lychee, while its taste combines floral tea, sweet fruit, and subtle spices. It has a medium-length finish with lingering herbal and floral sweetness, making it suitable for serving over ice or mixing with tonic water and soda.

sections.Description: Ardbeg 10 Years Old is a renowned Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky known for its intense peat smoke, maritime character and remarkable complexity. Matured in ex-bourbon casks and bottled at 46% ABV, it balances powerful smoky and peaty flavours with natural malt sweetness. The nose opens with smoky fruit, citrus, menthol and tarry notes, while the palate develops layers of lemon, lime, pepper, spiced toffee, brine, ripe banana and creamy coffee. Its long, smoky finish leaves lingering notes of espresso, liquorice, toasted almonds and peat. Ardbeg describes it as a signature expression of its distinctive Islay style

notes: Powerful peat smoke with lemon and lime, black pepper, cinnamon-spiced toffee, brine, buttermilk, ripe banana and currants, followed by creamy cappuccino, toasted marshmallow and espresso

sections.Description: Laphroaig 10 Year Old is one of the defining Islay Single Malt Scotch Whiskies, renowned for its bold peat smoke, coastal character and distinctive medicinal notes. Matured for 10 years in ex-bourbon barrels, it delivers an unmistakably maritime profile with peat smoke, seaweed, salt and subtle sweetness. On the nose, intense peat smoke and seaweed are accompanied by iodine-like medicinal notes and hints of sweetness. The palate is full-bodied, smoky and surprisingly sweet, with layers of peat and salt, while the long, lingering finish leaves a characteristic seaweed and smoky afterglow. It is an iconic choice for drinkers who enjoy powerful, heavily peated Islay whisky

notes: Full-bodied and smoky, with surprising sweetness, sea salt, layers of peat, vanilla and oak character

sections.Description: Louis Roederer Cristal 2016 is an iconic prestige vintage Champagne produced from 58% Pinot Noir and 42% Chardonnay, sourced from 32 vineyard plots across some of Champagne’s finest Grand Cru sites. The 2016 vintage benefited from a cool and wet spring followed by a warm, dry and sunny summer, allowing the Pinot Noir to develop intense ripe fruit character while the Chardonnay retained its characteristic precision and saline freshness. The wine displays a bright golden appearance with exceptionally fine, slow-moving bubbles. On the nose, it reveals an elegant combination of acacia and white flowers, roasted lemon, ripe peaches and mirabelle plums, gradually developing delicate iodised, powdery and toasted nuances. On the palate, Cristal 2016 is concentrated yet remarkably refined, combining juicy ripe fruit with a soft, caressing texture and perfectly integrated, almost saline bubbles. Its chalky mineral character brings notes of oyster shell, wheat, citrus and subtle roasted chocolate nuances. The finish is exceptionally long, crystalline, fresh and saline, leaving a sophisticated mineral impression. A prestigious Champagne suited to celebrations, luxury gifting, fine dining and collectors

notes: Soft and delicate texture, fine integrated bubbles, saline minerality, chalk, oyster shell, citrus and subtle roasted/chocolate nuances

sections.Description: Hennessy Very Special (V.S) is a bold and fragrant French Cognac matured in new oak barrels. It offers a vibrant combination of toasted and fruity characteristics, with a rich and clearly defined palate. On the nose, fresh toast, roasted almond and brown sugar are complemented by subtle vine fruit aromas. The palate is rich and creamy, bringing forward smooth vanilla notes, while the finish is fresh and floral. Versatile and approachable, Hennessy V.S can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as a base for classic and contemporary cocktails

sections.Description: Martini Bianco Vermouth is a classic Italian white vermouth crafted from quality white wines, including Trebbiano, and infused with a carefully selected blend of aromatic herbs and botanicals. It has a distinctive pale golden appearance and a smooth, elegant character. The nose offers delicate aromas of vanilla, aromatic herbs and subtle floral notes. On the palate, it delivers a light and refreshing profile balanced by gentle sweetness, with soft vanilla and botanical flavours creating its signature taste. The finish is smooth, fresh and pleasantly lingering. Versatile and approachable, MARTINI Bianco can be enjoyed neat, over ice, or used as a base for refreshing cocktails such as a Bianco Spritz

sections.Description: Bacardi Carta Negra Dark Rum is a medium-bodied dark rum crafted by the Maestros de Ron BACARDÍ. Its rich and distinctive character develops through maturation in heavily charred oak barrels, creating a deep and robust flavour profile. The nose offers toasted and nutty aromas, while the palate combines sweet tropical fruit with buttery caramel and smooth vanilla. As the flavour develops, richer molasses and smoky characteristics emerge, leading to a distinctive smoky finish with liquorice and molasses notes. Versatile and full of character, BACARDÍ Carta Negra can be enjoyed neat or used as a bold base for dark rum cocktails such as a Tormenta Negra, Dark ‘n’ Stormy, Jungle Bird or other tropical mixed drinks
